response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) as bytes_per_ms FROM MediaType mt INNER JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name) SELECT MediaTypeId, Name, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms / AVG(bytes_per_ms) OVER () as normalized_ratio FROM media_type_stats ORDER BY MediaTypeId

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from the calculation, since computing bytes-per-millisecond requires both values to be present.

alternatives.interpretation: Include all tracks regardless of whether Bytes is NULL, allowing SUM(Bytes) to treat NULLs as omitted, dividing the sum of non-NULL bytes by the sum of all milliseconds.
